title: Scheduled inventory on the operations host
summary: The inventory worker collected the process list during the scheduled device audit. The ticket and the observed time window matched.
steps: Check the device audit window in the change record.

title: Archive worker exceeded its usual memory window
summary: The archive worker's working set rose during a backup. The case record has no external connections. Check the batch size against the previous run before closing the alert.
steps: Compare the backup window with the job schedule.
Check whether the working set returned to baseline.

title: Repeated outbound TLS connection from a sync worker
summary: A sync worker opened a connection to 198.51.100.18 over port 443. Compare the destination with the approved sync configuration before assigning a disposition.

references.description: Reference for interpreting web traffic. Port 443 alone does not establish intent.

steps: Check the sync service's expected destinations.
Compare connection times with the scheduled transfer.

title: Build worker thread spike during a release job
summary: The build worker reached 1,480 threads and a 2,048 MB working set during a release job. A process inventory ran in the same window. The analyst must check whether the release schedule explains both observations.

references.description: Process inventory can be part of a build diagnostic. Correlate the observed inventory with the job timeline.
Compare worker concurrency with the release plan and review the host after the build finishes.

steps: Compare the thread spike with the release job's start and finish times.
Confirm that the build owner requested a process inventory.
Record the disposition and the matching change ticket.
